title: Play while waiting silently does nothing when overlapping polls report the clip done
description:
Found while fixing the two red site Playwright acceptance tests ("Play while waiting starts Kokoro when audio arrives", "Play after the clip ends starts Kokoro speech from the beginning"), which fail on develop and every PR.

## Product bug

`embed/src/player/index.ts` polls `GET /jobs/{hash}` every 2 s with no in-flight guard. When responses are slow, several polls overlap and more than one resolves as `done`. Each one runs `applyJob`, which sets `audio.src` and calls `audio.load()` again. The second `load()` aborts the `play()` started for a pending Play ("The play() request was interrupted by a new load request"). The reader pressed Play, the clip appears, and nothing plays.

Fix: skip a poll while one is in flight, and ignore responses once the job has settled (done or failed).

## Stale tests

Commit 372065d replaced the hand-built Play/Pause toggle with native `<audio controls>`. The acceptance tests still waited for the custom button to read "Pause" and clicked a "Play" button that no longer exists after audio arrives. They now use real clicks on the pending button and on the native play control.

Proof: a vitest regression in `embed/tests/player.test.ts`, which fails before the fix. All 34 site Playwright tests pass locally against the live API.
